question: Does the distinct same-session VWAP defense/recovery coordinate have replicating next-session and neighboring-horizon state dynamics after fixed current-state controls?
research_role: outcome-blind temporal meaning after intraday representation and external compression

availability.predictor_available_at: completed decision-date derived session state at 15:30 Asia/Shanghai
availability.response_available_at: completed t+h derived session state at 15:30 Asia/Shanghai
availability.entry_predictor_use: forbidden; this experiment creates no action

fields.controls_relative_to_all: each controls_pit field minus its same-date/same-denominator ALL_A value

responses.construction: exact same coordinate at t+h shifted within view/denominator on the governed exchange-session sequence
responses.same_block_rule: predictor and response dates must both fall inside the temporal block

temporal_blocks.evidence_label: both blocks reuse pre-2024 time and are exploratory, not untouched confirmation

estimation.primary: partial Spearman by rank-residualizing predictor and response on three fixed current-session controls with intercept
estimation.relative_rank_groups: two denominators pooled across four governed views
estimation.sign: learned from block-A primary absolute median and required everywhere else
estimation.raw_unadjusted: diagnostic only; cannot rescue the fixed partial estimator

gates.no_rescue: No horizon, block, coordinate, aggregation, cross-section definition, view, denominator, sign, control deletion, failed role, or favorable subset can replace a failed primary state dynamic.

prohibited_fields: future market price return, future volatility, future industry state, or future stock state
strategy membership, signal, admission, trade, P&L, MFE, MAE, exit, duration, or outcome class
late_vwap_acceptance or price_volume_demand_balance as independent mechanisms
leave-one-component-out selection or any failed/redundant MKT-MIN role
claim_boundary: Passing establishes only a replicating outcome-blind same-session VWAP-defense/recovery state dynamic; it does not establish cross-day support/resistance, participant accumulation, causality, price or volatility prediction, habitat fitness, timing, execution, or a strategy rule.
